title: value objects are map keys: structural identity and order
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0; object keys allowed by #212
provenance.expected_basis: a value object key compares by its fields like ==: Card(10, hearts) replaces itself, keys() follows field order (rank, then suit in case order), and rat fields 1/3 and 2/6 are one key.
